PROGRAM
  MAPPING
    MAPPING_HEADER
      IDENT "User"
      SHAPE_SEP ":"
      IDENT "ex"
      SHAPE_SEP ":"
      IDENT "Person"
      KW_FROM "from"
      IDENT "users"
    MAPPING_BODY
      PROPERTY
        PROPERTY_LHS
          KW_IRI "iri"
        ASSIGN "="
        EXPR
          POSTFIX_EXPR
            LITERAL_EXPR
              IDENT "filter"
            LPAREN "("
            ARG_LIST
              ARG
                ERROR
                  COMMA ","
            RPAREN ")"
